notes: Fixes iPhone editor blinking after passphrase entry. The protected-record editor now uses a dedicated stationary Vault iframe instead of moving the Hub Vault iframe between containers, which can trigger repeated reloads in iOS Safari. Editing remains one path: open authorized records, choose a record, tap Edit, confirm the Couple passphrase only if needed, edit, and save.
name: TEE v3.4.83 — iPhone Vault Editor Stability
